import json

cats = {
 'op': "lovely terrible wonderful repulsive nice silly good ridiculous awful".split(),
 'size': "huge small normal-size midsize big tiny large massive enormous little medium-size".split(),
 'age': "old brand-new archaic ancient new old-fashioned".split(),
 'shape': "triangular square rectangular circular spherical pyramidal".split(),
 'mat': "paper iron steel cloth leather canvas glass plastic cardboard".split(),
 'color': "gray black blue brown magenta teal cyan pink violet green yellow red white".split(),
 'purp': "exercise eating driving snorkeling smoking walking typing whittling hiking drinking".split(),
 'orig': "egyptian indian mexican chinese ethiopian indonesian german american turkish nigerian bangladeshi".split(),
}
# 'canvas' in "brown canvas" is a noun; handled since only non-final words are classified
order = ['op','size','age','shape','mat','color','purp','orig']
w2c = {w: c for c, ws in cats.items() for w in ws}

def ok(s):
    ws = s.split()
    adj = ws[:-1]
    if any(a not in w2c for a in adj):
        return None
    idx = [order.index(w2c[a]) for a in adj]
    return all(idx[i] < idx[i+1] for i in range(len(idx)-1))

data = """exercise egyptian shoe|old piano|eating banana|lovely huge bicycle|lovely candle|small apple|terrible normal-size necklace|wonderful gray driving bicycle|paper black shirt|snorkeling indian calculator|repulsive bag|smoking mexican vase|snorkeling ring|nice enormous pencil|triangular banana|walking mexican car key|silly massive candle|lovely normal-size knife|exercise jar|good screwdriver|ridiculous bed|midsize iron mexican jar|paper blue car|driving chinese sofa|brand-new calculator|square bed|brown canvas|ethiopian sunglasses|terrible guitar|small earring|indonesian dog|awful speaker|rectangular shoe|big vase|iron bowl|eating house|blue earring|black camera|huge cup|square car key|archaic circular speaker|ancient hat|indonesian lamp|exercise brush|brand-new triangular fire extinguisher|cloth banana|normal-size lamp|new rectangular cup|snorkeling american spoon|spherical saw|typing shoe|whittling book|circular bird|indonesian key|magenta bowl|german sofa|egyptian ruler|teal plate|cyan dog|snorkeling chinese jar|steel black pencil|paper banana|brand-new jar|tiny earring|repulsive large wallet|paper pink vase|wonderful candle|old-fashioned necklace|magenta house|paper violet clock|blue umbrella|leather pink bottle|square guitar|ethiopian car key|tiny umbrella""".split('|')

# nouns that are two words (car key, fire extinguisher) -> strip noun phrases
def strip(s):
    for n in ("car key","fire extinguisher"):
        if s.endswith(n):
            return s[:-len(n)] + "x"
    return s
data_ok = [ok(strip(s)) for s in data]

opts = {
'A':"good large leather red hiking german brand-new key",
'B':"circular glass pink hiking mexican little repulsive saw",
'C':"triangular old-fashioned iron pink eating turkish midsize canvas",
'D':"old cardboard black snorkeling nigerian large terrible fork",
'E':"terrible midsize cloth green walking american old pyramidal box",
'F':"awful tiny glass yellow smoking bangladeshi wrench",
'G':"lovely little plastic red drinking american pyramidal bowl",
'H':"old pyramidal leather violet whittling turkish chair",
'I':"ancient rectangular steel violet eating mexican normal-size wonderful watch",
'J':"medium-size plastic white walking bangladeshi old rectangular hat",
}
res = {k: ok(v) for k, v in opts.items()}
# "canvas" in C is a final noun, so it is skipped by ok(); that option fails earlier anyway
ans = "".join(k for k, v in res.items() if v) or "K"
print(json.dumps({"final_answer": ans,
                  "data_consistent": all(x is not False for x in data_ok),
                  "order": order,
                  "option_results": res}))
